Read November in America

Thanksgiving, Wobblies, Vampires, and the Coal Strike of 1927

Read it Online Now

Two teenagers are spirited back in time to witness the largest labor strike in Colorado history. Led by the IWW, or the “Wobblies”, over 12,000 coal miners went on strike for their dignity and better pay. It all leads to a shocking moment at the gates of the Columbine Mine. Featuring illustrated maps by Mister V.

BROWSE BOOKS

Nantucket Lit™ is a free and open-source platform that allows writers to create and share high-quality e-books. These e-books can be read directly in a web brow­ser without needing special apps or devices. The platform avoids using AI or DRM. E-books are written in Shanty™, a markup language specifically designed for e-books. Shanty can also be used to produce EPUB files and paperback books.

Support free and open e-books on Liberapay.
